parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the trashcan, typically made of stainless steel for durability and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the trashcan opening to contain odors and conceal waste. It opens when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge when the foot pad is pressed and returns to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad is a small pedal located at the base of the trashcan, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows hands-free operation by lifting the lid when pressed with the foot.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed, activating a lever mechanism that lifts the lid.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is a small connecting or hinge component linking the lid and the foot mechanism, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits mechanical motion from the foot pad to the lid, enabling synchronized movement.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rotates slightly to transfer motion between the pedal and the lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the trashcan, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main housing for all other parts.
